items.title: Ask it to teach you something
items.prompt: I want to understand how mortgages work in Ireland. Teach me step by step, ask me one question at a time, and check I understood before moving on.
items.tip: ChatGPT's pricing page lists Study mode on the Free plan. Check anything Ireland-specific with an official source.

items.title: Fix an email you're dreading
items.prompt: Rewrite this email so it is polite but firm, under 120 words, and ends with one clear next step: [paste email]
items.tip: Ask for 3 versions, then say which one you like and why.

items.title: Plan a week of dinners on a budget
items.prompt: Plan 5 weeknight dinners for 2 adults, under 30 minutes each, using ingredients from an Irish supermarket. Give me one combined shopping list grouped by aisle.
items.tip: Do not trust its prices. Use it for the plan and the list only.

items.title: Have a spoken conversation
items.tool: ChatGPT or Claude voice mode (Free, limited)
items.prompt: Let's practise a job interview for a [role]. Ask me one question at a time and give me feedback after each answer.
items.tip: Both pricing pages list voice on their free plans (ChatGPT says 'limited').

items.title: Build a tiny app without coding
items.prompt: Make me a simple interactive tip calculator in euro that splits a bill between friends.
items.tip: Claude's Free plan lists 'Create Artifacts'. Then try: 'add a dark mode'.

items.title: Make it show its sources
items.prompt: What changed in the latest AI model releases this month? Give me links to the official announcements for every claim.
items.tip: Click the links. If one doesn't support the claim, don't use the claim.

items.title: Turn a photo into notes
items.prompt: Here's a photo of my whiteboard. Turn it into tidy meeting notes with action items and owners.
items.tip: Never upload photos of IDs, bank cards or other people's private info.
